name: Deploy and operations (single VM)
summary: Everything that runs Velexis on one Ubuntu 24.04 VM without Docker: provisioning and its read-only check, the release-and-deploy pipeline with automatic rollback, Caddy with the Coraza WAF and on-demand TLS, seven sandboxed systemd units in five trust zones, PostgreSQL 16 and Redis 7.4 settings, the outbound allow-list, backups and restores, the on-VM health check, the security logs and their review, plus the GitHub workflows (CI, E2E, Deploy) that feed it.
audience: Owner and operator of the VM (deploys, rollbacks, backups, restore drills, alerts)
Bug hunter checking what a deploy, a health check or a backup actually changed
Developers changing units, the Caddyfile, env templates or the deploy scripts
package: none (bash scripts, Caddyfile, systemd units, SQL and env templates; no npm package)
stack: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, systemd (units, timers, transient units, DynamicUser)
Caddy 2.8.4 built with coraza-caddy v2.0.0, Coraza v3.8.1 and OWASP CRS v4.7.0 (Go 1.26.11, pinned SHA-256)
bash 5 + curl, jq, openssl, age, zstd, rclone, nftables, ufw, auditd, AIDE, fail2ban, chrony
GitHub Actions: ci.yml, e2e.yml, deploy.yml (actions pinned to full commit SHAs)
Tests: deploy.test.sh, healthcheck.test.sh, backup-restore.test.sh, ship-logs/log-review tests, check-vm.test.sh, units-smoke.sh, caddy-smoke.sh

local.notes: Locally only `dev-setup.sh` applies: it starts PostgreSQL 16 (127.0.0.1:5432) and Redis 7.4 (127.0.0.1:6379), runs `deploy/postgres/bootstrap.sql` with the development passwords of `.env.example` (development only: `dev_migrator`, `dev_provisioner`, `dev_platform`, `dev_ota`, `dev_test_admin`, Redis `dev_redis`) and refuses to run where `/etc/velexis` exists. Then `pnpm dev:keys`, `pnpm build && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed:reference`, `pnpm dev`. The VM scripts have test harnesses that run without root (`bash deploy/scripts/test/deploy.test.sh`, `healthcheck.test.sh`, ...); never run `provision-vm.sh` or `check-vm.test.sh` on your own machine.

production.host: One VM; public hosts platform.example.com, admin.platform.example.com, api.platform.example.com, admin.ota.example.com, api.ota.example.com, *.ota.example.com and verified custom domains (ports 80/443 via Caddy, 22 for SSH)

talksTo.how: Caddy proxies api.platform.example.com to 127.0.0.1:3100; on-demand TLS asks GET 127.0.0.1:3100/internal/tls/ask; velexis-deploy polls 127.0.0.1:3100 and :3101 /health/ready

Caddy proxies api.ota.example.com and storefront /api/* to 127.0.0.1:4000 (X-Velexis-Edge, X-Velexis-Host set by Caddy); deploy publishes the tenant fan-out report via velexis-run ota node dist/cli.js tenants:report-migrations
Caddy proxies platform.example.com to 127.0.0.1:3000 (maintenance page on 502/503/504); unit velexis-portal
Caddy proxies admin.platform.example.com to 127.0.0.1:3001; unit velexis-platform-admin
Caddy proxies admin.ota.example.com to 127.0.0.1:3002; unit velexis-ota-admin
Caddy serves /srv/velexis/current/storefront as static files with a strict CSP; the health check compares the payment pages with payment-page-inventory.json daily
Runs @velexis/db migrate.js (platform, reference, tenants) and the reference-data loader as transient units with a dynamic user

data: /var/lib/velexis/* state files (deploy-history, caddy-dropin.sha256, reference-data.sha256, migrate-<sha>.json, backup-last-success, healthcheck/, egress/, ship-logs/, log-review/, provision/)

roles.name: Developer / operator (admin user)
roles.can: SSH with key + FIDO2 or TOTP second factor, sudo: provision, check-vm, velexis-deploy, velexis-run, backups, restores, emergency egress openings

roles.name: deploy (system user)
roles.can: SSH key only (restrict, no TTY); rsync into /srv/velexis/incoming and sudo /usr/local/sbin/velexis-deploy only

roles.name: GitHub production environment
roles.can: Holds DEPLOY_HOST, DEPLOY_USER, DEPLOY_SSH_KEY, DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS; the deploy job needs the developer's approval and runs only from main or v* tags

roles.name: Zone users velexis-platform, velexis-ota, velexis-portal, velexis-platform-admin, velexis-ota-admin
roles.can: Run their units; read releases via group velexis; backend zones read their own key folder; no env file, no other zone

roles.name: caddy
roles.can: Runs Caddy; owns /run/caddy (admin socket); reads world-readable storefront files

roles.name: PostgreSQL roles
roles.can: velexis_migrator (DDL, deploy only), velexis_provisioner (tenant schemas), velexis_platform_app (DML platform/reference), velexis_ota_app (DML tenants, read platform/reference)

endpoints.purpose: Activate an uploaded release, roll back to the previous one, or show current release and unit states (all three take the deploy lock; root only)
One-off CLI as a zone user with its unit's env files, folder and sandbox (exit 125 = refused)
On-VM checks every 5 min; alerts only on state changes

endpoints.path: sudo velexis-restore list | fetch | db | storage | redis | config | drill
endpoints.purpose: Fetch, verify and restore a backup set; scratch database by default
Ship security logs (hourly :05) encrypted to the bucket's logs/
Hourly review (:20), immediate alerts, daily summary after 06:00 UTC

endpoints.path: sudo velexis-egress [refresh | validate | check-apt | apt-hosts | parse]
endpoints.purpose: Load/refresh the nftables table inet velexis_egress (every 2 min)
Idempotent VM provisioning: packages node harden users postgres redis caddy keys database envfiles scripts caddyconf summary (+ ssh, egress by name)
Read-only PASS/FAIL per hardening item; never prints a value
Local PostgreSQL/Redis bootstrap with development passwords
Build release/<sha>/ with RELEASE.json, SHA256SUMS and caddy/bin/caddy (CI)
Loopback readiness of each unit (3000-3002, 3100, 3101, 4000, 4001); 404 through Caddy
Caddy's on-demand TLS gate; 200 issues a certificate, 404 refuses (positive answers cached in Redis tlsask:<host> 60 s)

endpoints.path: Actions > Deploy > Run workflow (main or v*)
endpoints.purpose: build (no secrets) + e2e, then deploy (production environment, approval)

endpoints.path: CI on every pull request and push to main
endpoints.purpose: plan-lint, deploy-files, systemd-units, check-vm, dev-setup, build-test, integration, alt-hosts, sdk-node22

endpoints.path: E2E nightly 02:23 UTC, on demand, label e2e, called by Deploy
endpoints.purpose: Playwright projects portal, platform-admin, storefront, ota-admin (+ Stripe projects, SDK smoke)
